title: Drive to Bridgestone Arena with Pool, Bar + Gym
description:
Experience Memoir Residential in Nashville’s Wedgewood-Houston, where design, comfort, and hospitality meet. Relax by the pool with cabanas, work out anytime in the 24/7 gym, play pickleball, or enjoy a cocktail at the lobby bar. Just minutes from Broadway, the Country Music Hall of Fame, and local breweries, Memoir is your launchpad to Music City. Even closer, catch a game at Geodis Park or explore the Nashville Fairgrounds & Speedway.

The space
Top Reasons Guests Book This Stay

• Dive into the resort‑style pool deck with cabanas, lounge seating, and cold plunge—built for chill & recharge 
• Stay fit 24/7 in the fitness studio with Peloton bikes and cardio gear—right by the pool 
• Grab your morning brew or evening cocktail at the full‑service coffee & cocktail bar on-site 
• Enjoy communal perks: pickleball court, putting green, ping-pong, fire pit, and a billiards lounge—all accessible in a professionally managed residential building 
• Experience life in Wedgewood‑Houston—Nashville’s arts district with galleries, craft bars, and walkable local flavor 

 Your Premium One Bedroom Apartment
Welcome to your personal Nashville penthouse—682 square feet of comfort and craftsmanship designed for short-term stays that don’t sacrifice style. Whether you’re here for work, music, or a getaway with flair, this king-bedded corner of Wedgewood-Houston is filled with thoughtful touches, like Made In cookware, antique brass hardware, and operable awning windows for a breezy vibe.

 Apartment Highlights
• 1 King bed with Parachute linens for luxe-level sleep
• Spacious open-concept living & dining area
• Fully equipped kitchen with gas stove + stainless steel appliances
• Made In cookware, barware, and Fellow pour-over kettle
• Nespresso Vertuo Next Premium for your morning brew
• Spa-style bathroom with Grown Alchemist bath products
• In-unit washer & dryer for ultimate convenience
• Free high-speed Wi-Fi + Smart TV
• Pet-friendly setup + concierge and housekeeping available
• Factory-inspired architecture with exposed concrete ceilings and navy finishes

 Perks You Won’t Find in Most Airbnbs
• Outdoor pool with shaded cabanas
• 24/7 fitness studio with free weights & cardio machines
• Coffee and cocktail bar in the lobby
• Game-inspired amenities: pickleball court, putting green, fire pit & ping-pong
• Pet wash station, fenced dog park & EV charging available 
• Concierge, package lockers & residential services
• On-site self‑parking available (fees apply) 

 Nearby Favorites
• GEODIS Park Stadium – home to Nashville SC 
• Broadway – ~9-min drive to Nashville’s legendary honky-tonks, neon signs, and rooftop stages
• Country Music Hall of Fame – ~7-min drive to soak in legendary sounds
• Ryman Auditorium – ~8-min drive to the “Mother Church of Country Music” and iconic performances
• Music City Center – ~5-min drive to downtown’s premier convention and event venue

Guest access
Front desk assistance available from 7:00 am to 11:00 pm

Other things to note
Good to Know Before You Book

 Check-In & Deposit
• Check-in: 4:00 PM until 11:00 PM / Check-out: 11:00 AM
• You must be 21 to rent this room. Only the person's name on the booking will be allowed to check in.
• Valid photo ID and credit card required at check-in. Special requests are subject to availability; additional charges may apply.
❗ IMPORTANT NOTE: Guests who do not check in as scheduled will be considered a no‑show.

 Fees & Inclusions
• Daily resort fee: $29.19 per day (includes tax) included in your total rate.
• Includes access to building amenities, in-room coffee, and fibre internet

 Parking
• Paid self-parking available: $21 max per entry

 Pet Policy
• Pets welcome with a $75 fee per stay, max 2 pets per room.

 Laundry & Essentials
• In-unit washer and dryer in every apartment
• All units include full kitchens with dishwasher, oven, and cookware

 Amenities Airbnb Guests Love
• Expansive pool deck with lounge seating & cabanas
• 24/7 fitness center with Peloton bikes
• Coffee & cocktail bar on-site
• Putting green, pickleball court, and outdoor fire pit
• Community lounge with billiards and co-working
• Controlled-access building with concierge support
